matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the exact same inconsistency: Lemma 3.1's gap condition (δ_p > 5||E||) conflicts with Theorem 2.1's stated condition (4||E|| < δ_p), and notes the proof itself uses a different threshold than the lemma statement, matching the cross-passage inequality inconsistency described in GT1.

No finding addresses the ambiguity of whether the max in Theorem 2.3 is over the boundary or interior of the rectangle Γ1; findings 4, 5, and 7 discuss other issues with Theorem 2.3 and its proof (the best-rank-p claim, M2/M4 bound errors, N2/N4 constant mismatch), none of which concern the Γ1 boundary/interior notation ambiguity.
